description: This file contains utility functions for handling Fama-French datasets related to US and International portfolios and factors, including data retrieval, parsing, and processing functions.

methods.name: get_factor_choices
methods.description: Generates a list of factor or portfolio choices based on provided parameters, used for dropdown menus.

methods.name: download_file
methods.description: Downloads a dataset file from the Ken French data library, with caching.

methods.name: download_international_portfolios
methods.description: Downloads international index or country portfolio data, used internally.

methods.name: apply_date
methods.description: Converts various date formats to a standard YYYY-MM-DD format.

methods.name: read_csv_file
methods.description: Parses raw CSV data into structured tables with metadata.

methods.name: process_csv_tables
methods.description: Converts parsed CSV tables into pandas DataFrames with metadata.

methods.name: read_dat_file
methods.description: Parses raw data from .dat files into structured tables.

methods.name: get_international_portfolio_data
methods.description: Downloads and extracts international index or country portfolio data.

methods.name: process_international_portfolio_data
methods.description: Converts parsed international portfolio tables into pandas DataFrames with multi-index columns.

methods.name: get_international_portfolio
methods.description: Retrieves international portfolio data for a specified index or country, with filtering options.

methods.name: get_portfolio_data
methods.description: Retrieves US portfolio data for a specified dataset, with filtering by frequency and measure.

methods.name: get_breakpoint_data
methods.description: Retrieves US breakpoint data for a specified breakpoint type.
